title: A Flying Jatt
desc: Aman who is scared of heights, discovers his superpowers when he is forced to face the evil Raka, who is sent by an industrialist to destroy humanity.

title: Geetha Govindam
desc: Vijay Govind, a young lecturer in a college, wishes to get married at the earliest. He tries to woo Geetha, an independent and a level-headed woman, who is not easy to convince.

title: Hero No. 1
desc: A man disguises as a servant and enters his lover's house to win the approval of her loved ones.

title: K3 - Kaali Ka Karishma
desc: A young man, who lives happily with his family but is scared of ghosts, visits Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, with his family. There, he is soon possessed by a vengeful ghost with a sinister past.

title: Narsimha
desc: Narasimha, an assassin, works for Bapji, a powerful thug, and kills people on his behalf. However, things take a turn when he is ordered to murder Ravi, and he declines to follow the order.
